judgment_text:
PRAYER : Appeal filed under Clause 15 of the Letters Patent to set aside the order passed by the learned Single Judge in W.P.No.30358 of 2022, dated 01.04.2024.

Sushrut Arvind Dharmadhikari, C.J.:— The learned counsel for the appellant seeks leave of the Court to withdraw the writ appeal.

2. The writ appeal is dismissed as withdrawn. There shall be no order as to costs. Consequently, connected miscellaneous petition is closed.
